title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI regression + quality gating enhancements
author: Ava Patel
description: Context: Teams relying on per-prompt quality checks need deterministic CI gates to catch regressions early. This PR introduces a per-prompt regression CI hook, a configurable quality-gating config, and integration points to emit per-prompt eval metrics to the metrics-service. Changes include a reusable GitHub Actions job, an eval-harness hook implementation, tests, and docs. Motivation: reduce manual post-merge regressions and enable automatic rollback/alerts when prompt-level quality drops. Checklist: [x] Add GH Actions job .github/workflows/eval-harness-ci.yml [x] Implement hook eval-harness/hooks/per_prompt_gate.py [x] Metrics emission to metrics-service via eval_harness.metrics.report_prompt_metrics [x] Unit and integration tests eval-harness/tests/test_per_prompt_gate.py [x] Config schema eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yaml [x] Docs docs/eval-harness/ci-gating.md Notes: The gate thresholds are configurable per-prompt-set; default thresholds match existing global gates to avoid surprises. The hook runs as an optional job; repo maintainers can opt-in by adding the workflow to their repo or by enabling the per-prompt gating flag in the team config. Related: ENG-2892 tracks follow-up to expose thresholds in the Console UI, ENG-3010 tracks adding canary rollout support for gating reactions.
